description: Prepare rolling a put over through its put router: a new loan of the same size on the same pledge repays it in full, and the wallet's USDG buys what the new payout leaves short. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

term.description: The new loan's term in seconds, one gage_capabilities lists; the loan's own term when omitted
